model_info.description: Model trained to predict NumberOfPieces using multiple exogenous and time series features. SPECIFICALLY DESIGNED for multi-location supply chain forecasting with Customer, Location, and BusinessType dimensions. USES LAG FEATURES (1, 3, 6 months) and ROLLING STATISTICS (3, 6, 12 months). Best choice when user requests: multiple locations, rolling statistics, lag features, or complex multi-dimensional forecasting.
key_capabilities: Handles multiple locations, customers, and business types simultaneously
Uses lag features (1, 3, 6 months) for historical patterns
Uses rolling statistics (mean and std for 3, 6, 12 month windows)
Robust feature engineering for complex supply chain scenarios
when_to_use: User asks for 'lag features' or 'historical patterns'
Data has Customer, Location, and BusinessType columns
User needs sophisticated monthly forecasting with advanced features

usage_notes.leakage_note: Includes current-period targets (TotalRevenue, NumberOfPieces) as input features, which must be filled with NaN for prediction.
